title: PSRR at 1kHz and 100kHz (small-signal AC around the DC operating point)
claim: Substantiates spec/target-spec.md's DRAFT "PSRR" row (>50dB @ 1kHz and >20dB @ 100kHz) against the LDO core-regulation-loop schematic landed by #14 (design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch). That row is DRAFT (issue #1 not yet ratified) -- the bounds below cite it directly, not an invented final limit, and need re-verification once #1 rules. This v1 testbench characterizes ONE load point (~1mA, 1.8kOhm) rather than both 1mA and 50mA the DRAFT row names -- see the testbench schematic's header for why (the 50mA point does not have a valid regulating DC operating point to linearize around, per this schematic's known compensation/gain immaturity, design/README.md "Known gaps").
statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix check, not a distribution claim)

measurements.name: psrr_1khz_db
measurements.note: PSRR at 1kHz (index 0 of the 3-point 'ac lin 3 1e3 1e5' sweep -- ngspice's 'ac lin 2 ...' form drops a point on this deck, so a 3rd, unused midpoint is requested to work around it). DRAFT bound: spec/target-spec.md "PSRR" row, >50dB @ 1kHz.

measurements.name: psrr_100khz_db
measurements.note: PSRR at 100kHz (index 2, the sweep's upper endpoint). DRAFT bound: spec/target-spec.md "PSRR" row, >20dB @ 100kHz.
